description: ALMA's radiometer as ALMASim models it: what a run uses unless its noise model's radiometer component sets its own (services.noise_model).
receiver_temperature_notes: What ALMA's own Tsys (SYSCAL) on the noise study's 12 m windows implies under ALMASim's Tsys model (MADIV-28; bands 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7, 8 to 29 windows each); bands 8 to 10 (one to three windows) keep the earlier estimates.
aperture_notes: Aperture efficiency against frequency (Ruze): eta0 exp(-(4 pi eps / lambda)^2). Fitted to the efficiency ALMA's noise and Tsys imply on the noise study's 100 windows (MADIV-28). Any other diameter takes the 12 m dish's.
